name: ModelVariant648_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant648_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (one or two rows of up to 48 elements, each set up from a command row and released in waves; every element spins a cluster of fading sprites outwards from its position, then draws a fan of spoke strips over it, for 32 frames); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-665 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant665_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-665 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant665_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-665 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant665_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
